content.summary-text: Applying Data Science (understanding why systems behave the way they do), Data Engineering (designing reliable large-scale data pipelines), and Machine Learning (predicting future outcomes) to analyze complex computing workloads and generate actionable insights.
content.ranklab-bullet-1: Led end-to-end engineering of ranklab.org, a large-scale analytical platform for policy comparison, ranking, and sentiment visualization built using PHP, MySQL (PDO), Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
content.ranklab-bullet-2: Owned the full system stack including backend architecture, schema design, data ingestion pipelines, ranking algorithms, and frontend visualization interfaces without external frameworks.
content.ranklab-bullet-3: Translated complex civic datasets and policy inputs into structured systems for large-scale analysis while coordinating contributors responsible for data validation and preparation.
content.ranklab-bullet-4: Architected the platform to support machine learning and predictive analytics workloads including gradient boosted models, generative AI analysis, and structured feature extraction.
content.ranklab-bullet-5: Designed scalable analytical infrastructure capable of evaluating policy decisions, fiscal outcomes, and taxpayer ROI through structured metrics and visualization pipelines.
content.apple-bullet-1: Engineered large-scale data collection and processing systems supporting Apple AI/ML teams, handling terabytes of image, video, and text data across distributed AWS EMR clusters.
content.apple-bullet-2: Operationalized machine learning workflows including video similarity detection, embedding indexing, and time-series forecasting to reduce redundant labeling and improve dataset quality.
content.apple-bullet-3: Developed high-throughput Python data pipelines, refactored ETL systems for multiprocessing, and implemented monitoring and logging to analyze large-scale engineering workloads.
content.apple-bullet-4: Built distributed data processing workflows using PySpark and Airflow for large research datasets, enabling scalable analysis for Apple Health machine learning initiatives.
content.apple-bullet-5: Produced visual analytics and SQL-driven reporting for engineers and leadership, linking infrastructure changes to data trends to guide ML pipeline optimization decisions.
content.redstone-bullet-1: Built GUI-driven internal tools, dashboards, and data visualizations to let non-technical stakeholders interact with server-side scripts, algorithms, and reporting systems.
content.redstone-bullet-2: Developed bots, CLIs, and APIs to automate scraping, data ingestion, file processing, and ETL workflows across Linux and Windows servers, triggered by schedulers, scripts, user actions, and third-party APIs.
content.redstone-bullet-3: Implemented SQL automation, stored procedures, and efficient algorithms (O(1)-O(n^2)) to process hundreds of weekly CSV, text, and PDF files, enabling statistical analysis, audits, forecasting, and cost reduction.
content.mhetadata-bullet-1: Rebuilt revenue-generating image automation software from the ground up by reverse-engineering legacy code, increasing throughput from 100K to 500K+ downloads per month.
content.mhetadata-bullet-2: Optimized algorithms via asynchronous non-blocking I/O to dramatically reduce processing time (24 min -> 2 min per 2K images).
content.mhetadata-bullet-3: Developed and deployed full-stack production systems using AngularJS, PHP, SQL Server, and APIs, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and UX-driven interfaces.
content.lab916-bullet-1: Designed and deployed cloud-based data systems (MySQL on GCP, AWS APIs) with full CRUD functionality and SQL-driven data processing.
content.lab916-bullet-2: Built KPI dashboards and reporting pipelines (Google Data Studio, Excel) to analyze and visualize business and marketing performance.
content.lab916-bullet-3: Developed client-facing web applications and marketing sites with authentication, analytics, and interactive/animated forms.
